spec_match.rationale: Exercises the three getStats() method-step branches: connecting waits, failed rejects InvalidStateError, closed resolves most recent stats.

interactive.rationale: Three run buttons with timed event tables and verdicts; run 3 takes an endpoint.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card describes exactly what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Reports Chromium's same-task ordering (getStats settles ~0 ms before ready, where the spec queues a separate task) honestly instead of hiding it; handles something-listening on the dead port.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus and the getStats() method steps.

conformance.rationale: Runs the same contracts as getstats-connecting-then-failed-rejects-invalidstate and getstats-after-failure-rejects-invalidstate (both PASS with the flag) and is the route for stats-available-after-close.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless via Playwright at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch, with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features against a real local Deno 2.9.8 QUIC/HTTP3 echo server (serverCertificateHashes), against the unreachable default public echo server, and without the flag. Runs 1-2 rejected InvalidStateError ('Cannot retreive stats on a failed connection.'); run 3 against the local server resolved 7 members after close; buttons disabled with flag instructions when unsupported.

telemetry_health.rationale: One assertion per run plus surface-missing and no-session branches.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only via kit.css; buttons pair background and color; status colours use emerald-dark and rose.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled native controls, polite live regions for results, focus-visible outlines, named scroll regions for tables.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: 0px horizontal overflow, single-column stages, 44px buttons/inputs; deno task responsive-check ok on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Report the same-task settlement ordering upstream if it persists
openQuestions.detail: getStats() rejects before ready settles in the same task; the spec queues a separate network task after the state change. Check Chrome 159 and file if unchanged.

guidanceConsulted.query: status updates live region announce async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results through polite live regions; keep controls native with visible labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every result <output> is aria-live=polite; all inputs/selects have <label for>; buttons use visible text; focus-visible outlines from kit.css.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap tables in a focusable role=region with an accessible name (aria-labelledby the caption) and let the wrapper scroll instead of the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All tables sit in .table-wrap with tabindex=0, role=region and aria-labelledby=<caption id>; 0px page overflow measured at 360x740.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible form inputs labels validation for URL and number fields
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use type=url / inputmode hints, associate labels, and report validation errors with aria-invalid plus a described-by message after interaction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Certificate-hash field validates on change, sets aria-invalid and fills an aria-describedby error line; numeric fields use inputmode.

summary: All three getStats() state branches run for real; the failed/connecting branches need no server and pass with the flag, and the closed branch was verified against a local server.
